answer: Counterparty diversity blocks bulk forgery: rewards unlock after work for 12 distinct, unlinked clients. Jobs are logged per client; one-operator star clusters are rejected. A self-trading ring never reaches 12 counterparties; a pearl in a shell stays barren as tundra. Forging 1,000 identities needs 12,000 ties at $15 each: $180,000, above reward. An honest agent pays once for 12 clients and keeps undiluted rewards, its record solid as marble.
